subject: Executive clearance: Solstice service-credit cap and pricing concession
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@solstice.ai>, legal@solstice.ai
Date: 2026-05-31T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: concession for Solstice - uptime target & pricing ask

Team —

Quick summary: Solstice is asking for two non-standard commercial items as part of DL-3487:
- A higher service-credit exposure if we miss their uptime tolerance for multi-region inference (they want a 7% annual credit cap instead of our standard 3%).
- A commercial concession: 20% off list on their first-year committed capacity in exchange for a 12-month commit and a joint technical integration roadmap.

They flagged this as a blocker to signing this week. Attachments: Solstice_SOW_v3.pdf and DL-3487-pricing.xlsx (pricing model & requested concession).

Asking for executive clearance to negotiate a compromise we can sign without a multi-week deal desk loop. My suggested compromise to present to the customer:
- Grant a one-time increase to the service-credit cap to 5% (annual) with explicit remediation milestones and SLA exclusions for scheduled maintenance and third-party infra events.
- Offer a 15% first-year discount (instead of 20%) tied to a 12-month committed spend and a minimum monthly consumption floor.

If we get signoff, I will update the SOW and forward to Legal for redlines and DocuSign. Need a quick yes/no or an alternate term set by EOD Friday (2026-06-04).

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: Solstice_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW draft), DL-3487-pricing.xlsx (requested concession vs baseline)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-01T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: concession for Solstice - uptime target & pricing ask

Aditya —

Thanks for the summary and the attachments. Quick thoughts:
- I am open to a limited service-credit concession but want Finance and Legal to weight in on the cap and the conditionality. We cannot leave an open-ended exposure.
- The customer request for 20% is steeper than our standard concession bands; 15% seems reasonable as a maximum if tied to strong commitment and baseline spend.
- Require SOC2 + evidence of a security review before we accept expanded credit exposure; also add a clause limiting credits to incidents attributable to our stack (not customer misconfig or third-party outages).

Hannah: please confirm operational/uptime thresholds we should require (SLO buckets, scheduled maintenance windows).
Vivek: need your read on the financial impact of a 5% vs 7% cap and the correct accounting treatment for the proposed credits and discount.

If everyone is aligned, I will clear to Aditya to present the counter-offer to Solstice and instruct Legal to prepare the redlines.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Request: concession for Solstice - uptime target & pricing ask

Marissa / team —

Finance has reviewed the exposure and the deal economics. We can approve a controlled, conditional concession with the following firm guardrails:
1) Discount: Approve a 15% first-year discount instead of the requested 20%, contingent on a 12-month committed ARR and a minimum monthly usage floor (to be defined in the SOW). Discount will be applied as monthly invoice credits across months 1–6 to preserve cashflow.
2) Service-credit cap: Approve raising the annual service-credit cap to 5% (not 7%). The cap applies to chargebacks related solely to Redwood-managed availability failures.
3) Governance & security: Require current SOC 2 report (Type II) and completion of our security intake checklist before any change in SLO exposure is accepted.
4) Remediation & rollback: Include automatic rollback clause — if the customer is flagged for repeated avoidable incidents (more than 2 incidents in a rolling 90-day window attributable to customer misconfig), the concession is rescinded for the remainder of the term.
5) Exec visibility: Any payment/credit >2% of annual contract value requires a second sign-off from the CFO.

Legal: please prepare the contractual language to capture the cap, exclusions for third-party events, and the rollback clause. Once Legal drafts the redline, Marissa can approve the final offering to the customer.

Vivek Kulkarni
SVP, Finance | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-06-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Approved terms and next steps for DL-3487 (Solstice)

Daniel —

Thanks again for the candid conversation this week. We reviewed your requests and have an approved counter-offer we can move forward with. High level:
- Discount: 15% off list for year one, applied as invoice credits across the first six months, conditional on a 12-month committed ARR and a monthly minimum usage floor.
- Service-credit exposure: Annual cap increased to 5% (from our standard 3%) for Redwood-managed availability failures. Credits do not apply to scheduled maintenance, third-party network/provider outages, or customer-caused incidents.
- Security & governance: Signature of the agreement requires current SOC 2 Type II evidence and completion of our security intake.
- Rollback: Concession rescinded if more than two avoidable incidents attributable to customer configuration occur in any rolling 90-day window.

Next steps (please confirm by reply):
1) Confirm you accept these terms in principle.
2) I will instruct Legal to issue the redlined SOW/Order Form and route for signatures (DocuSign).
3) Provide SOC 2 Type II and any security materials to security@redwood.ai.
4) We will schedule a kickoff technical integration meeting with our Solutions Engineering team once the signed SOW is in place.

DocuSign + redline link will be sent once Legal prepares the order form (target: 48 hours after confirmation). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567.

If this is acceptable, please reply with an explicit yes and attach SOC documentation. We will aim to execute and start onboarding the week of 2026-06-15.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
